benefits: Free nutritious breakfast every school day for students studying in Tamil Nadu government schools
description: Provides a free morning meal to children in government primary schools to improve nutrition and school attendance.

title: Illam Thedi Kalvi (ITK)
districtEligibility: All Tamil Nadu Districts
benefits: Free after-school and home-based supplementary learning support delivered by community volunteers
description: Learning-recovery programme that sends trained volunteers to villages and neighbourhoods to give extra academic support to government school students, especially in foundational literacy and numeracy.

title: Vetri Laptop Scheme
districtEligibility: All Tamil Nadu Districts
benefits: Free laptop for eligible first-year government/government-aided college students
description: Provides a free laptop to students joining government and government-aided arts, science and engineering colleges to support digital learning.

title: Free Bicycle Scheme for Girl Students
districtEligibility: All Tamil Nadu Districts
benefits: Free bicycle for girl students who complete Class 10 and continue into Class 11 in government/aided schools
description: Encourages girls in rural areas to continue higher secondary education by removing the transport barrier to school.

title: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST Students (Tamil Nadu)
department: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department
districtEligibility: All Tamil Nadu Districts
benefits: Tuition fee reimbursement plus a monthly maintenance allowance for SC/ST students in post-matric courses
description: State-implemented scholarship covering tuition fees and a living allowance for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe students pursuing courses beyond Class 10.

title: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS)
districtEligibility: All Tamil Nadu Districts
benefits: Cashless health insurance cover of up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year at empanelled government and private hospitals
description: Flagship health-insurance scheme giving low-income families in Tamil Nadu cashless treatment for over 1,000 surgical/medical procedures.

title: Makkalai Thedi Maruthuvam (MTM)
districtEligibility: All Tamil Nadu Districts
benefits: Free doorstep delivery of medicines and basic checkups for non-communicable disease patients aged 45+
description: Home-based healthcare programme that sends field health teams to deliver hypertension/diabetes medication, palliative care and physiotherapy to people with restricted mobility.

title: Amma Baby Care Kit
districtEligibility: All Tamil Nadu Districts
benefits: Free baby-care kit with essential newborn items given to every mother delivering in a government hospital
description: Provides new mothers with a kit of essential newborn-care items at the time of hospital discharge, at no cost.

title: Tamil Nadu 108 Ambulance / Emergency Care Initiative
districtEligibility: All Tamil Nadu Districts
benefits: Free, round-the-clock emergency ambulance response and transport to the nearest government hospital
description: State emergency medical response service providing free ambulance transport for accident victims and medical emergencies anywhere in Tamil Nadu.
documents: None required at point of use

title: Destitute Widow Pension Scheme
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department
districtEligibility: All Tamil Nadu Districts
benefits: Monthly pension of Rs 1,000 to destitute widows with no regular source of income
description: Social security pension paid monthly to widows who lack a stable income source, administered through the Social Welfare Department.

title: Destitute Old Age Pension Scheme
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department
districtEligibility: All Tamil Nadu Districts
benefits: Monthly pension of Rs 1,000 for destitute senior citizens above 60 with no means of livelihood
description: State old-age pension paid to elderly residents of Tamil Nadu who have no regular income or family support.

title: Differently Abled Pension Scheme
department: Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons
districtEligibility: All Tamil Nadu Districts
benefits: Monthly pension of Rs 1,000 to persons with 40% or more benchmark disability
description: Monthly cash assistance for persons with disabilities who are unable to earn a regular livelihood, paid through the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons.

title: Tamil Nadu Millet Mission
districtEligibility: All Tamil Nadu Districts
benefits: Input subsidies and support for cultivation of Cumbu, Cholam, Ragi and minor millets
description: State mission promoting millet cultivation among Tamil Nadu farmers through seed subsidies, training and market linkage support.

title: Cotton Renaissance Mission
districtEligibility: All Tamil Nadu Districts
benefits: Five-year support package for cotton farmers covering seeds, extension services and market linkages
description: State mission to revive cotton cultivation in Tamil Nadu with subsidised inputs and technical support for cotton-growing farmers.

title: Drop by Drop Water Scheme (Micro-Irrigation Subsidy)
districtEligibility: All Tamil Nadu Districts
benefits: Subsidy of up to 100% for small/marginal farmers to install drip and sprinkler micro-irrigation systems
description: Micro-irrigation subsidy scheme helping farmers switch to water-efficient drip and sprinkler irrigation to reduce water use and improve yields.

title: Uzhavar AI Scheme
districtEligibility: All Tamil Nadu Districts
benefits: Free AI and machine-learning based crop advisories delivered to farmers' mobile phones
description: Digital advisory scheme that uses AI/ML models to send farmers personalised crop, pest and weather advisories via SMS/app.

title: New Entrepreneur-cum-Enterprise Development Scheme (NEEDS)
districtEligibility: All Tamil Nadu Districts
benefits: Collateral-free bank loan of up to Rs 50 lakh with capital subsidy for first-generation entrepreneurs
description: Flagship Tamil Nadu scheme helping educated first-generation entrepreneurs set up new manufacturing or service enterprises with subsidised, collateral-free loans.

title: TAHDCO Loan Scheme for SC/ST Entrepreneurs
department: Tamil Nadu Adi Dravidar Housing and Development Corporation (TAHDCO)
districtEligibility: All Tamil Nadu Districts
benefits: Subsidised term loans and margin-money assistance for SC/ST entrepreneurs starting small businesses
description: TAHDCO provides collateral-light loans and subsidy support to Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe individuals in Tamil Nadu to start or expand small enterprises.

title: Backward Classes Economic Development Corporation (BCEDC) Loan Scheme
department: Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department
districtEligibility: All Tamil Nadu Districts
benefits: Low-interest term loans for BC/MBC/Minority individuals to start small businesses or self-employment ventures
description: State corporation loan scheme offering subsidised credit to Backward Class, Most Backward Class and Minority community members for income-generating activities.

title: Payroll Subsidy Scheme for MSMEs
districtEligibility: All Tamil Nadu Districts
benefits: Reimbursement of a share of employee wages to registered MSMEs that create new jobs
description: Wage-subsidy scheme encouraging Tamil Nadu MSMEs to hire more workers by partially reimbursing employer-side payroll costs for new employees.

title: Chief Minister's Green House Scheme
department: Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Department
districtEligibility: All Tamil Nadu Districts
benefits: Fully-built subsidised house (Green House) for houseless rural poor families
description: Rural housing scheme providing a completed pucca house, rather than only a construction subsidy, to landless and houseless families in Tamil Nadu villages.

title: Tamil Nadu Slum Clearance Board Housing Scheme
districtEligibility: All Tamil Nadu Districts
benefits: Free or highly subsidised tenement housing for eligible slum-dwelling families in urban areas
description: Urban housing and slum-rehabilitation scheme that relocates and rehouses eligible slum families into multi-storey tenements with basic amenities.

title: Naan Mudhalvan Skill Training Programme
districtEligibility: All Tamil Nadu Districts
benefits: Free industry-aligned skill training, certification and placement support for students and job seekers
description: State-run employability mission offering free skill-development modules in colleges plus dedicated training and placement support for unemployed youth.

title: TN Free Electricity Scheme (200 Units)
department: Tamil Nadu Generation and Distribution Corporation (TANGEDCO)
districtEligibility: All Tamil Nadu Districts
benefits: First 200 units of electricity free every two-month billing cycle for domestic consumers
description: Auto-applied electricity subsidy: eligible domestic TANGEDCO consumers pay zero bill if their household consumption stays within 200 units per two-month cycle.
documents: None — auto-applied to eligible domestic accounts

title: Chief Minister's Solar Rooftop Subsidy Scheme
districtEligibility: All Tamil Nadu Districts
benefits: Capital subsidy of up to 40% on rooftop solar panel installation for residential consumers
description: State subsidy on top of the central rooftop solar subsidy, helping Tamil Nadu households cut installation costs for grid-connected rooftop solar systems.

title: Free Rice / PDS Scheme (Tamil Nadu)
department: Civil Supplies and Consumer Protection Department
districtEligibility: All Tamil Nadu Districts
benefits: Free rice (up to 20 kg per family per month) plus subsidised essential commodities via ration shops
description: Public distribution system providing free rice and subsidised staples such as sugar, pulses and cooking oil to ration cardholders across Tamil Nadu.

title: Marriage Assistance Scheme for Government Employees' Children
districtEligibility: All Tamil Nadu Districts
benefits: One-time cash assistance towards the marriage of a government employee's son or daughter
description: Financial assistance paid to serving or retired Tamil Nadu government employees when their son or daughter reaches legal marriageable age and gets married.

title: Old Age Homes Scheme
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department
districtEligibility: All Tamil Nadu Districts
benefits: Free shelter, food and basic medical care for destitute senior citizens in government-run old age homes
description: Provides free residential care — shelter, food and basic healthcare — to elderly persons in Tamil Nadu who have no family support.
